title: RefundPayment
description: Compensation from checkout: undo the checkout's payment. Refunds it in full when it succeeded (idempotency key checkout-{checkoutId}-refund), cancels the PaymentIntent when it is not final (requires_action included), otherwise re-publishes the failure. Replies: payments.refunded or payments.payment-failed. Keyed by checkoutId.

reason.description: Why the checkout is being undone.

customerId.description: The checkout's customer. Optional only for compatibility: checkout always sends customerId, amount and currency. When they disagree with the payment, payments logs an error and does not refund.

amount.description: Minor units (cents) the checkout charged: the quote total.
